item.title: Retired SEAL Team 6 member hospitalized after 5-car crash near Lake Wales
item.description: A retired Navy SEAL who once served with SEAL Team 6 is recovering after being seriously injured in a deadly five-car crash near Lake Wales.

item.title: Paid parking unanimously approved on Indian Rocks Beach
item.description: The Indian Rocks Beach City Council unanimously approved a six-month parking pilot program Tuesday night, which will change all free spots along the water to $4.50 an hour.
